title: Environment Parameter Gradient Theorem for Co-Design in Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2607.12590v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) is traditionally concerned with learning a control policy for a fixed environment. In many engineering systems, however, the environment itself is alterable, i.e., physical or operational parameters can be tuned to shape the system's transition dynamics and costs experienced by the RL agent. This motivates jointly optimizing both the policy and the environment design parameters. To this end, we establish an Environment Parameter Gradient Theorem --- a formal expression for the gradient of the RL's objective function with respect to environment parameters. translated_title: 强化学习中协同设计的环境参数梯度定理
translated_abstract: 强化学习（RL）传统上关注为固定环境学习控制策略。然而在许多工程系统中，环境本身是可变的，即可以通过调节物理或运行参数来塑造RL智能体所经历的系统转移动力学和代价。这促使我们对策略和环境设计参数进行联合优化。为此，我们建立了环境参数梯度定理——这是RL目标函数关于环境参数的梯度的形式化表达式。关键的理论工具是一个广义动作值函数 $Q_{\pi,\xi}(s,a,\zeta)$，它包含环境参数的两个副本：ζ 管控当前状态-动作对处的代价和转移动力学，而 ξ 管控未来的展开过程。这种解耦产生了可处理的闭式梯度表达式。
tldr: 本文提出环境参数梯度定理，通过引入包含两份环境参数副本的广义动作值函数实现解耦，为强化学习中策略与环境的协同设计（联合优化）提供了可处理的闭式梯度表达式。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes an Environment Parameter Gradient Theorem that enables joint co-design of policy and environment in reinforcement learning, using a generalized action-value function with decoupled environment parameter copies to yield a tractable closed-form gradient expression.
